mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) signals rising economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <50% of triggered instances despite sustained GDPC1 growth (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% per annum, signaling aggressive rate hikes, S&P 500 forward returns turn negative over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20d returns remain negative even when FEDFUNDS >4.5%, or positive returns occur in >60% of such periods (p<0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent upward movement in FEDFUNDS and downward movement in UNRATE (unemployment) indicates easing monetary policy and labor market improvement, driving positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: Interaction occurs but 20d returns are negative, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS↑ and UNRATE↓ is weak (IC <0.2).

mechanism_narrative: Rapid monthly inflation (CPIAUCSL) growth exceeding 2% in a month during a late-cycle expansion triggers positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when CPIAUCSL growth >2% in late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in INDPRO (supply) above 105.5 indicates stronger production capacity, resulting in positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 5d returns not positive when INDPRO >105.5, or IC <0.1 over 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment (PAYEMS) falling below 140,000 (6.9% unemployment rate) triggers positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as labor market tightens.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive when PAYEMS <140k, or IC <0.15 over 6-month period.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous quarterly growth in both GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) above their 6-month averages drives positive 60-day S&P 500 returns through expanded economic activity.
failure_condition: 60d returns not positive despite both proxies rising, or IC <0.2 over 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In an expanding economy regime, simultaneous quarterly growth in GDPC1 (demand) above 18,794 and INDPRO (supply) above 105.6 leads to positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 5d returns not positive in expanding economy regime when both proxies meet thresholds, or IC <0.15 over 3-month window.
